name: amirsalmani-suite
title: The Amir Salmani suite
description: A shadcn registry of 30 items drawn to one brand — two grounds, no accent hue — with a static catalogue in front of it at amirsalmani.com/suite.

upstream.note: The mark, the palette, the type and the motion rules live there and are not restated here. This suite adds three grammar rules and the shapes that follow from them.

generated.note: shadcn registry, one JSON per item. Served from amirsalmani.com/r/. Never hand-edited.
the catalogue and the served registry. Copied into amirsalmani-com/site/. Never hand-edited.
render proofs. Regenerate rather than edit.

authored.note: the one dataset. The registry, the catalogue and the proofs all read this and nothing else.
one CSS file per registry item. Nothing below tokens.css contains a hex.
one HTML fragment per item — the live preview and the copy-paste snippet are the same file, so they cannot disagree.
the spring, extracted from amirsalmani.com/app.js, which stays the source of truth.
hand-drawn on the canonical grid, regular weight.
the lockup, React and plain CSS.
the three grammar rules, and what was rejected.
where the lockup goes and why it stays small.
why the catalogue is shaped the way it is, and what it took from where.

checks.asserts: 100 checks: every foreground role against the ground it actually lands on, with the alpha chain composited, on every surface the tokens can produce
every mark renders at 16/24/32/64 on both grounds
every item's demo renders on both grounds and under prefers-contrast: more
the catalogue loads with no console error under the CSP amirsalmani.com actually serves — script-src 'self', style-src 'self', no unsafe-inline
the registry regenerates from src/manifest.mjs, and refuses to emit an unresolved dependency
types in vocabulary, every link resolves

receives: the made-by lockup in every colophon
the made-by rules appended to site/styles.css
downstream.note: Copied, not symlinked. `node tools/build-site.mjs && cp -r dist/r dist/suite ../amirsalmani-com/site/` is the whole deploy step.
